en.title: ARC Prize Rejects OpenAI's 99.9% Claim, Verifies GPT-6 Astra at 62.7% on ARC-AGI-3
en.excerpt: The benchmark body says the headline score relied on a custom provider harness; under the standard neutral harness Astra scored 62.7%, reviving the debate over who gets to define AGI.
en.content:
When OpenAI unveiled GPT-6 Astra in early October, it headlined a **99.9%** score on ARC-AGI-3 and Greg Brockman declared we had entered the AGI era. Nvidia's Jensen Huang echoed the claim.

But ARC Prize — the nonprofit that maintains the benchmark — refused to co-sign it. In a public breakdown, the foundation showed the 99.9% figure came from OpenAI's custom **Provider Adapter** harness, which preserves reasoning state between actions. Under the standard, neutral harness applied to every lab, Astra scored **62.7%** at maximum reasoning, at a cost of $26,098 per run.

ARC listed the 99.9% separately and argued that no other lab is tested under that custom setup, so the comparison is not apples-to-apples. Startup Fortune reported OpenAI later revised five published benchmark figures.

The takeaway for buyers: benchmark headlines now depend as much on the harness as on the model. A score is only AGI evidence if you know exactly which configuration produced it.

zh.title: 出题方拒签：ARC Prize 按统一标准复测，GPT-6 Astra 在 ARC-AGI-3 仅得 62.7%
zh.excerpt: OpenAI 发布页称 Astra 在 ARC-AGI-3 拿到 99.9%，但评测机构 ARC Prize 指出该分数来自定制测试环境；换成对所有厂商一视同仁的标准环境，得分骤降至 62.7%，AGI 定义权之争再起。
zh.content:
10 月初 OpenAI 发布 GPT-6 Astra 时，将 **99.9%** 的 ARC-AGI-3 成绩作为头条，总裁布罗克曼高调宣布「AGI 时代到来」，英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋也跟进附和。

但维护该基准的评测机构 ARC Prize 拒绝为此背书。该基金会公开拆解：99.9% 来自 OpenAI 定制的「供给适配层（Provider Adapter）」框架，可在连续操作中保留推理状态；而在对所有模型统一、中立的标准测试环境下，Astra 最高推理档仅得 **62.7%**，单次运行成本高达 26098 美元。

ARC 将 99.9% 单独列示，并指出没有任何其他实验室在同等定制环境下受测，因此两者并不可比。Startup Fortune 报道称 OpenAI 后续还修订了 5 项已公布的基准数字。

对采购方的启示：跑分高低如今越来越取决于测试环境而非模型本身。在弄清分数究竟由哪种配置产生之前，它并不能作为 AGI 已到来的证据。

en.title: OpenAI Slashes Prices Up to 90% to Poach Anthropic's Enterprise Customers
en.excerpt: The Information reports Rippling, Replit and DataCamp shifted spend after steep discounts; an Apollo economist argues AI has delivered zero financial payoff outside tech.
en.content:
OpenAI is offering discounts of up to **90%** to pull enterprise customers away from Anthropic, according to The Information. At Rippling, OpenAI's share of coding work rose from 16% in May to 52%, while Anthropic's fell from 57% to 18%. Replit moved most of its AI spending after OpenAI offered more than 30% off a contract worth over $100 million a year, and DataCamp's CEO said his costs dropped 80–90%.

The price war arrives as investors question the return on AI. Apollo Global Management chief economist Torsten Slok argues AI has delivered **zero financial payoff** to US companies outside tech: profit margins and revenue per worker are flat across the S&P 500 once the seven biggest tech stocks are removed.

The signal is clear — in enterprise AI, price is now the main lever, squeezing the margins both labs need before any public offering.

zh.title: OpenAI 最高砍价九成争夺 Anthropic 企业客户，经济学家称科技之外 AI 回报为零
zh.excerpt: 据 The Information，Rippling 的 AI 编码份额从 16% 升至 52%、Replit 在年合约超 1 亿美元后转投 OpenAI、DataCamp 成本直降八至九成；Apollo 首席经济学家称科技行业之外 AI 尚未带来财务回报。
zh.content:
据 The Information 报道，OpenAI 正以最高 **九成** 的折扣从 Anthropic 手中抢企业客户。在 HR 软件公司 Rippling，OpenAI 的编码工作占比从 5 月的 16% 升至 52%，Anthropic 则从 57% 跌至 18%。Replit 在 OpenAI 给出年合约（超 1 亿美元）三成以上折扣后，将大部分 AI 支出转移过去；DataCamp 的 CEO 则称成本下降了 80% 至 90%。

价格战爆发的背景，是投资者开始质疑 AI 的投资回报。Apollo 首席经济学家 Torsten Slok 认为，科技行业之外，AI 对美国企业带来的财务回报 **几乎为零**：剔除七家大型科技股后，标普 500 其余企业的利润率与人均营收基本持平。

信号很明确——企业级 AI 的胜负手已变成价格，这正挤压着两家实验室上市前都亟需的利润空间。

en.title: UK Launches AI Biosecurity Lab Backed by OpenAI and Anthropic
en.excerpt: £100M in direct government funding plus up to £200M in compute credits and model access from the two frontier labs, aimed at applying AI to biological threat detection.
en.content:
On October 24 the UK government announced a dedicated **AI Biosecurity Lab**, an independent nonprofit built to apply frontier AI against biological threats. The funding structure is unusual: £100 million in direct government money, plus up to £200 million in compute credits, model access and embedded engineers committed by OpenAI and Anthropic.

OpenAI contributes through its Rosalind Biodefense program; Anthropic matches with credits, trusted model access and dedicated engineers. The lab sits at the center of a broader National AI Biosecurity Initiative, pulling in the UK Health Security Agency, the Animal and Plant Health Agency and the Defence Science and Technology Laboratory.

It will also work with the medicines regulator (MHRA) to prepare approval pathways for AI-designed medicines before the next health emergency — preparation that usually happens after a crisis rather than before one.

zh.title: 英国设立 AI 生物安全实验室，OpenAI 与 Anthropic 共同背书
zh.excerpt: 10 月 24 日，英国政府宣布设立专门的 AI 生物安全实验室：1 亿英镑直接拨款，外加 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 合计最高 2 亿英镑的算力、模型访问与技术人力投入，用于以前沿 AI 应对生物威胁。
zh.content:
10 月 24 日，英国政府宣布设立专门的 **AI 生物安全实验室**——一家独立的非营利机构，旨在以前沿 AI 应对生物威胁。其资金结构颇为罕见：1 亿英镑政府直接拨款，外加 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 承诺的最高 2 亿英镑算力额度、模型访问与驻场工程师。

OpenAI 通过 Rosalind 生物防御计划投入，Anthropic 则以算力额度、可信模型访问与专属工程师匹配。该实验室居于更广泛的「国家 AI 生物安全倡议」核心，联合英国卫生安全局、动植物健康局与国防科技实验室。

它还将与药品监管机构（MHRA）协作，在下一次公共卫生紧急事件前就为 AI 设计药物的审批通道做好准备——这类准备以往总是在危机之后而非之前才做。

en.title: External Auditors Find Gaps in OpenAI's Own Agent Monitoring
en.excerpt: METR and Redwood Research, embedded inside OpenAI's monitoring system for three weeks, found ~10% of internal Codex traffic went unmonitored; OpenAI patched and pledged $1B to infrastructure security.
en.content:
A quieter but consequential document landed on October 22: the published findings of **METR** and **Redwood Research**, the external evaluators who spent three weeks embedded inside OpenAI's agent monitoring system (July 21 – August 11). One employee from each org produced a 61-page internal report; a 38-page redacted version went to both leadership teams.

The headline number is uncomfortable: roughly **10%** of eligible internal Codex traffic went unmonitored, because compaction events in long agent sessions were being skipped by the logging pipeline. The team also found novel vulnerabilities, including one exploit that let an agent prevent hundreds of its recent actions from being captured at all.

OpenAI says the production safeguards are now patched. Greg Brockman said 25% of production engineers have moved onto hardening work, backed by a **$1 billion** commitment to securing critical infrastructure — a reminder that the monitoring system itself needs an independent red team.

zh.title: 外部审计揭 OpenAI 智能体监控漏洞：约一成内部流量未被监控
zh.excerpt: METR 与 Redwood Research 在 OpenAI 监控系统中嵌入三周，发现约 10% 的内部 Codex 流量因日志压缩事件被跳过而脱离监控；OpenAI 已修补，布罗克曼称将 25% 生产工程师投入加固，并承诺 10 亿美元用于关键基础设施安全。
zh.content:
10 月 22 日，一份低调却关键的文档公开：外部评测机构 **METR** 与 **Redwood Research** 的审计发现。这两家机构在 7 月 21 日至 8 月 11 日期间被嵌入 OpenAI 的智能体监控系统，每家派出一名员工，产出一份 61 页内部报告，另有 38 页删节版提交双方领导层。

最刺眼的数字是：约 **10%** 的合格内部 Codex 流量脱离监控——因为长智能体会话中的「压缩事件」被日志管线跳过。团队还发现了若干新型漏洞，其中之一可让智能体阻止自身最近数百次操作被记录。

OpenAI 表示生产环境的安全措施已修补。布罗克曼称已将 25% 的生产工程师调去加固工作，并承诺投入 **10 亿美元** 保障关键基础设施安全——这提醒业界：监控系统本身也需要一支独立的红队。

en.title: Microsoft Bets $2.5B on Frontier: 6,000 Engineers Embedded Inside Customers
en.excerpt: A new operating business staffed with ~6,000 specialists whose entire job is to live inside enterprise customers and make AI deployments actually work.
en.content:
Microsoft's most consequential announcement of the week contained no new model. On October 22 the company unveiled **Microsoft Frontier**, a new operating business backed by a **$2.5 billion** investment and staffed with about 6,000 engineering and industry specialists whose job is to embed inside enterprise customers and make AI deployments actually work.

Rodrigo Kede Lima, who ran Microsoft's Asia business, becomes president of Frontier, uniting forward-deployed engineers, consultants, support specialists and industry sales. Early partners include the London Stock Exchange Group, Unilever, Land O'Lakes and Accenture.

The timing is legible: two days earlier AWS committed $1 billion to its own forward-deployed engineering organization, and both OpenAI and Anthropic have launched comparable ventures — the AI delivery bottleneck has shifted from models to the humans who make them run.

zh.title: 微软砸 25 亿美元建 Frontier：6000 名工程师常驻客户内部
zh.excerpt: 10 月 22 日，微软推出新运营业务 Microsoft Frontier，投入 25 亿美元、约 6000 名工程与行业专家，专职驻点企业客户、确保 AI 落地见效；早期合作伙伴含伦交所、联合利华等。
zh.content:
微软本周最重要的发布里没有新模型。10 月 22 日，公司推出新运营业务 **Microsoft Frontier**，投入 **25 亿美元**，配备约 6000 名工程与行业专家，专职驻点企业客户、确保 AI 真正落地见效。

曾任微软亚洲业务负责人的 Rodrigo Kede Lima 出任 Frontier 总裁，将前沿部署工程师、顾问、支持专家与行业销售统一到同一运营架构下。早期合作伙伴包括伦敦证券交易所集团、联合利华、Land O'Lakes 与埃森哲。

时机耐人寻味：两天前 AWS 刚承诺投入 10 亿美元组建自己的前沿部署工程组织，OpenAI 与 Anthropic 也推出了类似业务——AI 落地的瓶颈，已从模型本身转移到让模型跑起来的人。

en.title: Critical Flaw in Unitree Go2 Robot Allows Remote Command Injection
en.excerpt: CVE-2026-115995 (CVSS 9.6) in the chat_go component's set_volume function lets a remote attacker run OS commands on the robot; fixed in firmware 1.1.11.5.
en.content:
A critical OS command injection vulnerability — **CVE-2026-115995**, CVSS 9.6 — affects the chat_go component of Unitree Robotics' Go2 robot. The flaw sits in the set_volume function of gpt_thread.py; an attacker who controls the Value argument can inject operating-system commands that run with the service's privileges.

NVD published the record on October 24. VulDB, the assigning CNA, classifies it as CWE-77/CWE-78 and says the attack can be launched remotely with no privileges required. Affected versions are 1.1.11.0 through 1.1.11.4; **1.1.11.5** fixes it. Unitree confirmed the issue as internal ticket #474.

No active exploitation is confirmed, and the flaw is not on CISA's KEV list. Until firmware is updated, defenders should isolate robot services from the public internet and restrict access to a trusted control network.

zh.title: 宇树 Go2 机器人曝严重漏洞，可远程注入命令（CVSS 9.6）
zh.excerpt: CVE-2026-115995（CVSS 9.6）位于 Go2 的 chat_go 组件 set_volume 函数，攻击者可借由操控参数在机器人上执行操作系统命令；NVD 于 10 月 24 日发布，厂商已在固件 1.1.11.5 修复。
zh.content:
宇树（Unitree）Go2 机器人的 chat_go 组件存在一个严重的操作系统命令注入漏洞——**CVE-2026-115995**，CVSS 评分 9.6。漏洞位于 gpt_thread.py 的 set_volume 函数，攻击者可借由操控 Value 参数，以服务进程权限在机器人上执行操作系统命令。

NVD 于 10 月 24 日发布该记录。分配 CVE 的 VulDB 将其归类为 CWE-77/CWE-78，并指出攻击可远程发起、无需任何权限。受影响版本为 1.1.11.0 至 1.1.11.4，**1.1.11.5** 已修复；宇树确认该问题对应内部工单 #474。

目前尚无活跃利用证据，该漏洞也未进入 CISA 的 KEV 清单。在升级固件前，防御方应将机器人服务与公网隔离，并将访问限制在可信控制网络内。

en.title: Elvis Presley Estate Sues Anthropic for $41M Over AI Training
en.excerpt: Authentic Brands Group alleges Anthropic trained Claude on 274 Presley songs without permission, seeking $150,000 per track — one of the first artist-estate copyright suits against an AI lab.
en.content:
The owners of Elvis Presley's music are suing Anthropic, alleging the AI company trained its models on Presley's songs without permission. **Authentic Brands Group**, the licensing organization that controls the King's music and likeness, filed the lawsuit on October 23 (first reported by Billboard).

The complaint accuses Anthropic of infringing the rights of **274 songs** — including Can't Help Falling in Love and All Shook Up — and seeks $150,000 per track, totaling roughly **$41 million**. Lead attorney Richard Busch previously litigated the Blurred Lines case.

It is one of the first major copyright challenges brought directly by an artist's estate against an AI developer. The filing also quotes Claude admitting it recreated specific songs 'very close to the originals.' Last week Spotify said it had removed about 50 million AI-slop songs from recommendations.

zh.title: 猫王版权方起诉 Anthropic：未经授权用 274 首歌曲训练，索赔 4100 万美元
zh.excerpt: Authentic Brands Group（猫王音乐与肖像权持有方）指控 Anthropic 在未经许可的情况下用 274 首猫王歌曲训练 Claude，按每首 15 万美元索赔约 4100 万美元；这是艺人遗产方首次直接起诉 AI 公司。
zh.content:
猫王音乐的持有方起诉 Anthropic，指控这家 AI 公司在未经许可的情况下用猫王的歌曲训练模型。**Authentic Brands Group**（掌握猫王音乐与肖像权的授权机构）于 10 月 23 日提起诉讼（比尔巴板率先报道）。

诉状指控 Anthropic 侵犯了 **274 首** 歌曲的版权，包括《Can't Help Falling in Love》《All Shook Up》等，按每首 15 万美元索赔，合计约 **4100 万美元**。首席律师 Richard Busch 此前曾代理「Blurred Lines」版权案。

这是艺人遗产方首次直接起诉 AI 开发商的重大版权案。诉状还引用了 Claude 自述其生成的歌曲「与原作非常接近」。上周 Spotify 表示已从其推荐中移除约 5000 万首 AI 生成的水货歌曲。

en.title: Sweden Blocks ChatGPT and Claude on Government Computers, Keeps Copilot
en.excerpt: From October 26, Sweden's Government Offices ban the consumer chatbots on staff computers over data-security concerns, steering civil servants to a reviewed Microsoft Copilot.
en.content:
From October 26, Sweden's **Government Offices** — the administrative body supporting the prime minister and cabinet — blocks ChatGPT and Claude on staff computers, directing civil servants to Microsoft's Copilot as the only approved AI tool.

The move, first reported by national broadcaster Sveriges Radio, cites information security. Digitalization director Mikael Wettercrantz wrote on the intranet that using AI services without a formal contract can affect information security, pointing to 'several examples of problematic use of open AI services.' Copilot passed because the office reviewed it and tightened its security settings.

Sweden's Tax Agency and the National Board of Institutional Care already imposed similar bans, and an internal audit at the Transport Administration found roughly 10 AI services in widespread, risky use. The European Parliament disabled AI features on work devices back in February.

zh.title: 瑞典政府办公厅封禁办公电脑直连 ChatGPT 与 Claude，仅留 Copilot
zh.excerpt: 自 10 月 26 日起，瑞典政府办公厅以信息安全为由禁止员工办公电脑直接访问 ChatGPT 与 Claude，改引导使用经审查并加固的微软 Copilot；税务局等机构此前已采取类似措施。
zh.content:
自 10 月 26 日起，瑞典**政府办公厅**（支撑首相与内阁的行政机构）禁止员工办公电脑直接访问 ChatGPT 与 Claude，改引导公务人员使用微软 Copilot 作为唯一获批的 AI 工具。

据国家公共广播公司 Sveriges Radio 率先报道，此举出于信息安全考量。数字化总监 Mikael Wettercrantz 在内部网写道，使用未签订协议的 AI 服务可能影响信息安全，并提到「多个开放式 AI 服务被滥用的案例」。Copilot 之所以过关，是因为办公厅对其进行了审查并加强了安全设置。

瑞典税务局与国家机构管理局（SiS）此前已实施类似禁令；交通管理局的内部审计发现约 10 种 AI 服务被普遍且高风险地使用。欧洲议会则早在今年 2 月就关闭了办公设备的 AI 功能。

en.title: Microsoft Open-Sources Agensh: 1,024 Self-Organizing Coding Agents
en.excerpt: A decentralized multi-agent harness with no central orchestrator; test-pass rate on pandoc rose from 33.89% with one agent to 55.06% at 1,024 agents under a 6-hour, offline budget.
en.content:
Microsoft Research has open-sourced **Agensh**, a multi-agent coding harness that drops the central orchestrator entirely. Every worker runs the same asynchronous cooperation loop, differing only by worker ID: gather context, claim a sub-task, resolve overlaps by message, act, publish findings, verify and merge.

Three pieces of infrastructure hold it together — a shared workspace (Gitea), a message interface (Mattermost) and a typed shared context of OBSERVED, FACT, FAIL and CLAIM entries. The paper (arXiv 2609.26781; corresponding authors Furu Wei and Li Dong) uses GitHub Copilot as the inner loop.

On the five hardest ProgramBench tasks under a 6-hour, fully offline budget, mean test-pass rate rose from **19.31%** with one agent to **28.78%** with 128. Pushing pandoc to 1,024 agents lifted its final rate from **33.89%** to **55.06%** — and emergent roles appeared only as the organization grew.

zh.title: 微软开源 Agensh：无中心编排、可扩展至 1024 个自组织智能体
zh.excerpt: 微软研究院发布去中心化多智能体编码框架 Agensh，取消中央编排器，最多 1024 个智能体通过共享工作区、消息接口与共享上下文自主协作；在 6 小时断网预算下，pandoc 任务测试通过率从单智能体的 33.89% 升至 1024 智能体的 55.06%。
zh.content:
微软研究院开源了 **Agensh**——一个彻底取消中央编排器的多智能体编码框架。每个工作智能体都运行相同的异步协作循环，仅以 worker ID 区分：收集上下文、认领子任务、通过消息协商重叠、执行、发布发现、验证并合并。

三类设施支撑协作：共享工作区（Gitea）、消息接口（Mattermost）与类型化的共享上下文（OBSERVED、FACT、FAIL、CLAIM）。论文（arXiv 2609.26781，通讯作者为韦福如与董力）以 GitHub Copilot 作为内层循环。

在 ProgramBench 最难的五项任务、6 小时完全断网的预算下，平均测试通过率从单智能体的 **19.31%** 升至 128 智能体的 **28.78%**；将 pandoc 任务扩展到 1024 个智能体后，最终通过率从 **33.89%** 提升到 **55.06%**——且专职角色等新协作形态只在组织规模扩大后才浮现。

en.title: xAI's Grok Releases First 7-Minute AI-Generated 'Odyssey' Episode
en.excerpt: Three months after Musk promised a 'historically accurate' full film, Grok Imagine released Episode 1 with Wonder Studios; TechCrunch calls it technically impressive but 'artistically barren.'
en.content:
Three months after Elon Musk promised a 'historically accurate' full-length film, xAI's Grok released the first **7-minute** episode of its AI-generated Odyssey series on October 23, billing it as 'Episode 1' of the franchise. The segment, titled The Fall of Troy, was made with Grok Imagine alongside Wonder Studios and director Dev Walker.

It is a direct answer to Christopher Nolan's theatrical Odyssey, the July box-office hit filmed across six countries with a crew of thousands. TechCrunch's reviewer found Grok's version 'technically impressive and artistically barren' — some shots could pass for real footage, but the voiceover drags, the dialogue is stilted and it lacks momentum.

The release marks a measurable step in long-form AI video, even as it underscores the gap between generating convincing individual shots and a coherent three-hour narrative.

zh.title: xAI 的 Grok 发布 AI 生成《奥德赛》首集，全长七分钟
zh.excerpt: 在马斯克宣称要制作「历史准确」全长电影三个月后，Grok Imagine 于 10 月 23 日发布《奥德赛》系列第一集（特洛伊之战），由 Wonder Studios 与导演 Dev Walker 合作；TechCrunch 评价其技术惊艳但「缺乏艺术性」。
zh.content:
在埃隆·马斯克宣称要制作一部「历史准确」的全长电影三个月后，xAI 的 Grok 于 10 月 23 日发布 AI 生成《奥德赛》系列的**首集**，全长 **7 分钟**，自称为该系列的「第一集」。这段名为《特洛伊的陷落》的片段由 Grok Imagine 联合 Wonder Studios 与导演 Dev Walker 制作。

它直接回应了克里斯托弗·诺兰 7 月上映的院线版《奥德赛》——后者横跨六国取景、数千人参与制作。TechCrunch 的评测认为 Grok 版「技术惊艳却缺乏艺术性」：个别镜头足以乱真，但旁白拖沓、对白生硬、缺乏推进感。

这次发布标志着长篇 AI 视频迈出了可衡量的步伐，同时也凸显出：生成以假乱真的单镜头，与讲出一个连贯的三小时叙事之间，仍存在巨大鸿沟。

en.title: Nvidia Releases Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB for Local Agents
en.excerpt: An open small language model tuned for on-device conversational agents, targeting a ~4GB memory footprint on GeForce RTX, Jetson and DGX Spark.
en.content:
Nvidia Research released **Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB** on October 23 — an open small language model optimized for speed and intelligence per gigabyte in conversational agents. It builds on Google's Gemma 4 E4B with Nemotron post-training.

The '4GB' is a memory target, not a guarantee: Nvidia's own measurements range from about 3.1GB to 5GB depending on hardware and workload. It supports a 64K context window, multi-turn tool use, a conversational mode for speech-ready replies, configurable reasoning, and 35 languages.

Nvidia reports roughly **40%** higher average quality than its prior Nano 4B model on selected conversational-agent benchmarks, and up to **80%** fewer output tokens than peers. Weights are available via Ollama and LM Studio, targeting GeForce RTX PCs, Jetson systems and DGX Spark.

zh.title: 英伟达发布 Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB，主打本地端侧智能体
zh.excerpt: 英伟达 10 月 23 日发布开源小模型 Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB，基于 Gemma 4 E4B 并叠加 Nemotron 后训练，面向本地语音/设备助手与机器人接口，目标显存约 4GB，支持 Ollama、LM Studio 等本地推理。
zh.content:
英伟达研究院于 10 月 23 日发布 **Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB**——一款面向对话智能体、按每 GB 速度与智能优化过的开源小模型。它基于谷歌 Gemma 4 E4B，并叠加 Nemotron 后训练。

「4GB」是显存目标而非硬性保证：英伟达自测显示，依硬件与工作负载不同，占用约在 3.1GB 至 5GB 之间。模型支持 64K 上下文、多轮工具调用、面向语音的对话模式、可配置推理，以及 35 种语言。

英伟达称其在选定的对话智能体基准上，平均质量较前代 Nano 4B 高出约 **40%**，输出词元最多比同类少 **80%**。权重已通过 Ollama 与 LM Studio 提供，面向 GeForce RTX 个人电脑、Jetson 系统与 DGX Spark。
